Two Police Officers Accused in Kadambari Jethwani Case Transferred

Two police officers, Kanthi Rana and Vishal Gunni, who have been accused in the Kadambari Jethwani case, have been given new postings. Kanti Rana Tata has been named Traffic Inspector General, and Vishal Gunni has been appointed DIG Training.
